text: Ignazio Silone's Fontamara could not be published in Fascist Italy in 1933, so it was first published in German in Zurich that year. In 1944 the British circulated an Italian-language version to Italian prisoners of war. The original Italian edition appeared later; it was not published in Italy until 1945.
